init._comment: FLOW melody engine showcase (spec 2026-08-13 flow-melody-engine, task 10): a single SYNTH deck stays in FLOW at a slow RATE while DENSITY sweeps 0 -> 1, walking the whole continuum from a standing note (DENSITY 0, the single unmaskable anchor slot) to the full 8-slot phrase (DENSITY 1). Part 0's engine is left at its ENGINE_SYNTH boot default, so Part::init's set_flow_melody(true) push (part.cpp) is already in effect -- no separate flag to raise here.
Part B silenced: default lanes would otherwise siren its pitch (PITCH/LEVEL targets are active by boot default).

Part A: FLOW (not STEP) -- SuperModulator boots in FLOW already (_step_on defaults false), set explicitly so the scenario doesn't lean on that default. RATE 0.35 -> free_hz ~= 0.26 Hz, an ~3.9 s phrase cycle -- slow enough that a listener hears individual notes arrive, not a blur.

events._comment: 32s: DENSITY 1.0 -> the full phrase, held to the end so the last ~2 cycles are heard in full.
